title: The Handful of Smooth Counters
youtube_title: The Handful of Smooth Counters | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Dori sees that a handful of smooth game counters will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Dori makes a smaller, even share so Milo is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
